author: blu
body: Procedural world generator with progressive LOD. The world is a sphere subdivided into quad-tree tiles. At orbital distance you see continent outlines and ocean. As you descend, tiles subdivide: coarse heightmap refines, rivers carve, biomes fill in, flora populates. Each tile level doubles resolution and halves area. Tiles beyond a distance budget are not generated -- the world is infinite but only rendered where you look.
